text:
The provided onboarding document does not contain specific details regarding whether intermediate tool calls are intended to be streamed/published in chunks over the `/v1/chat/completions` API.

**Best Guess:**
When interacting with Hermes Agent via an OpenAI-compatible completion endpoint, the agent acts as an autonomous loop on the server side. It receives the prompt, executes the necessary internal tool calls (such as listing files) on the backend, and streams back only the final assistant response content and token usage chunks, rather than exposing intermediate `tool_calls` deltas to the client. If you need step-by-step tool execution visibility, you would typically monitor call tracing (e.g., via Langfuse plugins with `hermes plugins enable observability/langfuse`) or skill usage logs (`hermes insights`).
